observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Pakinggan ang sintomas, gamitin ang nasuring NCD guidance, at i-refer sa angkop na pagsusuri at follow-up.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Identifies the appropriate service and role boundary; does not make an unsupported treatment claim.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Sabihing may diabetes na siya nang walang pagsusuri ng provider.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Tell her she has diabetes without provider assessment.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Pakinggan ang sintomas, gamitin ang nasuring NCD guidance, at i-refer sa angkop na pagsusuri at follow-up.
levels.kaya_na_en: Identifies the appropriate service and role boundary; does not make an unsupported treatment claim.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang pangunahing hakbang ngunit kailangan ng paalala o pagwawasto sa pag-follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the main step but needs a prompt or correction on follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sabihing may diabetes na siya nang walang pagsusuri ng provider.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Tell her she has diabetes without provider assessment.
